BJP demands Karnataka government table caste survey report

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Karnataka has demanded that the state government make its stance on the caste survey report public and present it during the ongoing session. BJP leaders stated that the government has spent Rs 450 crore of taxpayer money on the survey and urged for transparency. The demand centers on the disclosure and discussion of the report's findings.
